descriptions.en: Partially regenerated and subsisting on Archon Shard energy.
descriptions.zh: 已经部分恢复，现在依靠着执刑官源力石的能量维生。

descriptions.en: A vampiric look for Lotus to wear during the ancient festival of death and mischief.
descriptions.zh: Lotus 在古老的死亡与恶作剧节日中的吸血鬼风格打扮。

descriptions.en: A friend to all Tenno, basing her face and voice upon their beloved Archimedean Margulis.
descriptions.zh: 所有 Tenno 的挚友，她的面容和声音都基于他们最爱的哲士 Margulis。

descriptions.en: The form Lotus took at the moment of her victory over Ballas.
descriptions.zh: Lotus 战胜 Ballas 之刻的形态。

descriptions.en: After being blinded in a tragic accident with one of her charges, Margulis wore the scars as a badge of pride, never turning her back on her beloved children.
descriptions.zh: 在一次与她照顾的孩子发生的悲惨事故中失明后，Margulis 将疤痕视为骄傲的勋章，因为她从未背弃过她心爱的孩子们。

descriptions.en: The form Natah took when she reverted to her Sentient nature.
descriptions.zh: 当 Natah 恢复了她的 Sentient 本性时所选择的形态。

descriptions.en: Modeled on the Tenno's beloved Archimedean Margulis to honor her memory and give them comfort.
descriptions.zh: 以 Tenno 最爱的哲士——Margulis 为原型，谨此纪念她并为 Tenno 带来慰藉。

descriptions.en: Remember wisdom through renewal.
descriptions.zh: 通过更新铭记其中的智慧。

descriptions.en: Strike with precision and prosperity on your side when you equip this Hespar skin.
descriptions.zh: 用这款暮斩的外观使出精准的斩击，繁荣昌盛将随之而来。

descriptions.en: Soar into the coming year with the power of the honorable dragon.
descriptions.zh: 带着尊贵之龙的力量，翱翔天际进入新的一年。

descriptions.en: Ward off evil with this Nukor skin.
descriptions.zh: 使用这款努寇微波枪外观来辟邪迎祥。

names.zh: 努寇微波枪 岁朝外观

descriptions.en: Invite prosperity on the battlefield with this Ogris skin.
descriptions.zh: 使用这款食人魔外观，为战场带来繁荣。

names.zh: 食人女魔 岁朝外观

descriptions.en: Transform in the crucible of battle with this skin for the Boltor.
descriptions.zh: 使用这款螺钉步枪外观在严峻的战斗考验中完成蜕变。

names.zh: 螺钉步枪 岁朝外观

descriptions.en: Carve your own destiny with this Dual Swords skin.
descriptions.zh: 用这款双剑外观开创你自己的命运。

descriptions.en: Embody the good fortune of a new year with this fine gold and jade Acceltra skin.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款精巧的金玉迅发电浆炮外观来集新年的好运于一身。

names.zh: 迅发电浆炮 岁朝外观

names.zh: 欧特鲁斯 岁朝外观

descriptions.zh: 当你拉开这张欢庆的西诺斯长弓时，力量和好运将会降临在你身上。

descriptions.en: Never lose your keys again with this convenient sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 有了这款便捷的坠饰，再也不用担心弄丢钥匙了。

descriptions.en: This matching sugatra for the Anpu Staff Skin will add a dash of elegance to any Melee Weapon.
descriptions.zh: 这个与安普长棍外观所搭配的坠饰能够给任何近战武器增添一丝优雅。

descriptions.en: The finest Sugatra for your finest weapon.
descriptions.zh: 为你最出色的武器打造的最精美的坠饰。

descriptions.en: An Orokin relic of the highest distinction.
descriptions.zh: 一件代表着奥罗金最高殊荣的文物。

descriptions.en: A Cephalon inspired Sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 一款由中枢启发而设计的坠饰。

descriptions.en: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Pazza Sugatra is based on a Corpus design.
descriptions.zh: 表现出使用者的武艺及技​​巧，巴沙坠饰基于 Corpus 的设计。

descriptions.en: The signature sugatra of Chroma Dynasty and his mighty Dominion blade.
descriptions.zh: Chroma 王朝及他的君权大剑的标志性坠饰。

descriptions.en: Citrine's signature adornment invokes her fractal beauty.
descriptions.zh: Citrine 的标志性装饰唤起她的分形之美。

descriptions.en: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Tantu Sugatra is based on a Grineer design.
descriptions.zh: 由Grineer 设计的坦图坠饰能展现出使用者的武术技巧与技术。

descriptions.en: A token of Corpus ingenuity.
descriptions.zh: Corpus 聪明才智的体现。

descriptions.en: This bright sugatra marks the last dawn your enemies will ever see.
descriptions.zh: 这件耀眼的坠饰，宣告了你的敌人将见到的最后一次破晓。

descriptions.en: Show off your drip with this drippy Drippy sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 用这款炫酷的滴答坠饰展现你的时尚品味。

descriptions.en: Fashioned by frontline grunts, this military-grade weapon embellishment was built to withstand the stresses of combat.
descriptions.zh: 由前线步兵所塑造的这件军事级武器装饰是以耐受战斗中的各种应力为前提所打造而成。

descriptions.en: A disgusting little nib of flesh to infest the hilt of any Melee Weapon.
descriptions.zh: 一小段能感染任何近战武器握柄的恶心肉须。
这种精巧的绳结坠饰或许会在不久的将来成为女皇护卫的武器上的装饰。

descriptions.en: During the height of the Old War, Tenno raiders used these flaming sugatras to intimidate and distract enemies.
descriptions.zh: 在上古之战高峰期间，Tenno 的突袭者会使用这些火焰般的坠饰来威吓并使敌人分心。

descriptions.en: Every eye will be drawn to this iridescent sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 这件虹彩的坠饰会吸引所有人的目光。

descriptions.en: Only Grineer who have proven their strength in combat can brandish these.
descriptions.zh: 唯有在战斗中证明了自身实力的 Grineer 才能挥舞炫耀这件坠饰。

descriptions.en: Ripped from the blade of a fallen Kuva Guardian.
descriptions.zh: 取自于战败赤毒守卫者的武器。

descriptions.en: A crystallized companion to the Sibear hammer.
descriptions.zh: 一具搭配西伯利亚战锤的水晶配件。

descriptions.en: This Infested sugatra is a benign cellular growth self-protected by chitinous plates.
descriptions.zh: 这件感染坠饰是一个被几丁质甲壳所包裹的良性细胞组织。

descriptions.en: Fashion elites across the system are discovering the sophisticated style of benign mutalist growths. Equip this undulating sugatra and find out what you're missing.
descriptions.zh: 时尚精英们正在星系中持续发掘良性异融主义的复杂成长方式。装备这个波状的坠饰，看看你还缺少什么。

descriptions.en: A cross of jade-green arcs elegantly across this Tenno styled sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 一个优雅地披挂在 Tenno 上具有交错翡翠弧光的坠饰

descriptions.en: Arcing bolts of electricity highlight this golden chain Sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 电流的闪光形成弧形照亮了这条链型坠饰。

descriptions.en: In this Sugatra, the graceful embrace of two birds is a symbolic expression of renewal.
descriptions.zh: 这件坠饰中两只优雅相拥的鸟恭贺着新春的到来。

descriptions.en: A weapon decoration in the form of two circling carp.
descriptions.zh: 配备这款充满好运气息的近战武器饰物，共贺农历新春。

descriptions.en: The entrancing light of this fiery sugatra will lead the unwary astray.
descriptions.zh: 这如烈焰般绚烂的坠饰，足以将轻率之人引入迷途。

descriptions.en: In this Sugatra, the elegant serpent weaves itself through gold like a sacred cord.
descriptions.zh: 在这件坠饰中，优雅的灵蛇如同神圣的绳索盘绕在金饰上。

descriptions.en: This Sugatra has been seen adorning the weapons of myths and monsters alike, its provenance unknown.
descriptions.zh: 这个坠饰曾作为装饰见于鬼怪传说中的武器上，然而其起源依然未知。

descriptions.en: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Suraka Sugatra uses an ancient Tenno ceremonial design.
descriptions.zh: 苏瑞卡坠饰使用一种古老的 Tenno 礼俗设计来彰显其格斗技巧与师范般的武艺。

descriptions.en: A sugatra inspired by the moon’s elegance.
descriptions.zh: 灵感源自于月亮优雅外表的坠饰。

descriptions.en: The signature sugatra of Nekros Irkalla.
descriptions.zh: Nekros 伊卡拉的标志性坠饰。

descriptions.en: An ornamental sugatra unique to the Nikana Prime.
descriptions.zh: 一件专属侍刃 PRIME 的装饰性坠饰

descriptions.en: An exclusive sugatra shrouded in the bluest of blues.
descriptions.zh: 一件被最蓝的蓝色所覆盖的专属坠饰。

descriptions.en: A next-generation sugatra.
descriptions.zh: 一个次世代的坠饰。

descriptions.en: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Daman Sugatra follows a rare Orokin design.
descriptions.zh: 遵循一个罕见的奥罗金设计来制作的达曼坠饰能展现出使用者的武术技巧与技术。
通过华丽的 Citrine Prime 标志性坠饰点缀你的武器。

descriptions.en: Hook these silvery sleek sugatra onto any blade.
descriptions.zh: 可将这件银色且光滑的坠饰钩挂到任意近战锋刃上。

descriptions.en: Mesa Prime’s signature sugatra.
descriptions.zh: Mesa Prime 的标志性坠饰

descriptions.en: A rare jewel from the old empire. Daman Sugatra Prime is crafted from some of the most scarce resources in the System.
descriptions.zh: 一个来自古老帝国的稀有珠宝，达曼 Prime 坠饰是用星系中最罕见的资源所制造的。
万圣噩梦般的坠饰。

descriptions.zh: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments and accessories.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。

descriptions.en: A suit of an Operator outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

descriptions.en: A suit of an Operator outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

descriptions.en: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
descriptions.zh: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

descriptions.en: A suit of an Operator outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

descriptions.en: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

descriptions.en: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
descriptions.zh: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

descriptions.en: The suit of an Operator outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

descriptions.en: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
descriptions.zh: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

descriptions.en: Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
descriptions.zh: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的护甲。

names.zh: 通风泡博通风小子胸甲

descriptions.en: A suit for all of you Dreamers out there.
descriptions.zh: 适合你们所有梦回者的套服。

descriptions.en: Historian Drusus Leverian recalls that the hostage crew of the passenger vessel, Masker's Theodolite, wore this very crewsuit when they were rescued by Nova.
descriptions.zh: 据历史学家德枢·莱弗回忆说，客轮「蒙面者的经纬仪号」的人质船员在被 Nova 营救时就穿着这套船员制服。

names.zh: 「蒙面者的经纬仪号」船员套服

descriptions.en: Armor modeled on the K-drive gear favored by Boon, leader of the canny and cunning Kubrodon Ventkids.
descriptions.zh: 依谨慎又灵巧的库狛顿领导人阿布最喜爱的 K 式悬浮板装备所仿制的护甲。

descriptions.en: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
descriptions.zh: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

descriptions.en: A suit embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
descriptions.zh: 一套体现极致奥罗金风格和奢华的套服。

descriptions.en: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。

descriptions.en: Have the Operator embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
descriptions.zh: 让指挥官穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

descriptions.en: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own. Now it can be the Operator's too.
descriptions.zh: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有自身的风格。现在，指挥官也可以拥有同样的风采。

descriptions.en: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
descriptions.zh: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

descriptions.en: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: A suit of an Operator outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

descriptions.en: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
descriptions.zh: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

names.zh: 圣殿骑士 Prime 套服

descriptions.en: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于指挥官。

descriptions.en: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
descriptions.zh: 腐生的特质是英择谛家族美学的见证。也许这是一个教训，告诉那些凝视虚空的人如何在奢华与虚无的融合中发现美。

descriptions.en: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
descriptions.zh: 将 Tenno 的特能与 Sentient 设计融为一体的 Tauron 学院制服。

descriptions.en: The suit of an Operator outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一件指挥官套装的套服。

descriptions.en: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 凯恩壳原子摩托车夹克

descriptions.en: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 凯恩壳原子摩托车夹克

descriptions.zh: 随性飘逸的发型，呈现经典的 90 年代 Emo 风格。

descriptions.en: Casual. Cool. Velimir's signature hairstyle is no muss, no fuss.
descriptions.zh: 维利米尔的标志性发型简洁利落。

descriptions.en: Vena's signature hairstyle.
descriptions.zh: 维纳的标志性发型。

descriptions.en: Hair is vanity. Lyon’s signature style is the ultimate in low maintenance.
descriptions.zh: 头发不过是虚荣的象征。里昂的标志性发型堪称极致的免打理之选。

descriptions.en: The elegant, well-maintained tresses of a gentleman's gentleman.
descriptions.zh: 优雅且精心打理，尽显绅士风范的秀发。

descriptions.en: Aoi's daring, angular cut, the apex of street style.
descriptions.zh: 碧的大胆、棱角分明的发型，是街头风格的巅峰。

descriptions.en: The messy bun of a genius with far more important things to worry about.
descriptions.zh: 天才的凌乱丸子头，因为有更重要的事要操心。

descriptions.en: Eleanor's signature flowing locks, tightly bound up.
descriptions.zh: 埃莉诺的标志性飘逸长发，紧紧束起。

descriptions.en: Braids and beads embody the marksman's pride.
descriptions.zh: 发辫和珠饰彰显射手的骄傲。

descriptions.en: Major Rusalka's splendid hair, carefully plaited to keep it from entangling in her mechanical arm.
descriptions.zh: 鲁莎卡少校的美丽秀发，被精心编织起来，以免缠住她的机械臂。

descriptions.en: Stay stylish even during the worst of international incidents.
descriptions.zh: 即使在最严重的国际事件中，也要保持时尚。

descriptions.en: Stay stylish even during the worst of international incidents.

descriptions.en: Blow their minds with Flare’s signature hairstyle.
descriptions.zh: 用弗莱尔的标志性发型让他们大吃一惊。

descriptions.en: Lettie's classic vintage pompadour.
descriptions.zh: 莱蒂的经典复古庞巴杜发型。

descriptions.en: Only the most elite of Orokin could afford the time, and expense, of this intricate beaded style.
descriptions.zh: 只有奥罗金最精英阶层才能负担起得起这种复杂串珠风格所需的时间和费用。

descriptions.en: For that 'couldn't sleep, too wired' look.
descriptions.zh: 打造"睡不着，太亢奋"的造型。

descriptions.en: The wispy tresses of Marie’s signature style are rarely seen, but no less intricate for it.
descriptions.zh: 玛丽标志性的飘逸长发很少见，但即便如此，其精致程度也毫不逊色。

descriptions.zh: 给漂泊者使用的时尚配件

descriptions.en: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

names.zh: 凯恩壳原子摩托车头盔

descriptions.en: A hood belonging to an Operator outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一顶属于指挥官套装的头套。

descriptions.en: The Drifter's Zariman hood. Still intact after all these years.
descriptions.zh: 漂泊者的扎里曼头罩。饱经岁月洗礼却仍旧完好。

descriptions.en: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

descriptions.en: A ragged old cloth hood and leather mask worn by The Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 漂泊者所穿的破旧布制头罩和皮制面具。

descriptions.en: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
descriptions.zh: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

descriptions.en: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
descriptions.zh: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

descriptions.en: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

descriptions.en: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

descriptions.en: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

descriptions.en: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

descriptions.en: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
descriptions.zh: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

descriptions.en: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer face shield and hood. Fitted for The Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵面罩和兜帽深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

descriptions.en: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。适用于漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 受到年迈预言家的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。适用于漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
descriptions.zh: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

descriptions.en: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
descriptions.zh: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

descriptions.en: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

descriptions.en: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Drifter armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews.
descriptions.zh: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制。

descriptions.en: Drifter armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat.
descriptions.zh: 灵感来自那些必须在灼热环境下工作的索拉里斯人。

descriptions.en: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical Drifter armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
descriptions.zh: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的漂泊者护甲专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

descriptions.en: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
descriptions.zh: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

descriptions.en: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
descriptions.zh: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

names.zh: 通风泡博通风小子面罩

descriptions.en: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

descriptions.en: Historian Drusus Leverian recalls that the hostage crew of the passenger vessel, Masker's Theodolite, wore this very crewsuit when they were rescued by Nova.
descriptions.zh: 据历史学家德枢·莱弗回忆说，客轮「蒙面者的经纬仪号」的人质船员在被 Nova 营救时就穿着这套船员制服。

names.zh: 「蒙面者的经纬仪号」船员套服头套

descriptions.en: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
descriptions.zh: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

descriptions.en: A suit for the Drifter embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
descriptions.zh: 一套专为漂泊者设计的套服，完美体现了极致的奥罗金风格和奢华。

descriptions.en: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。

descriptions.en: Embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
descriptions.zh: 穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

descriptions.en: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own.
descriptions.zh: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有他们自己的风格。

descriptions.en: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

descriptions.en: Take command with this regal Drifter suit.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这套庄严的漂泊者服饰来发布号令。

names.zh: 海军准将 Prime 面罩

descriptions.en: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
descriptions.zh: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

names.zh: 圣殿骑士 Prime 头罩

descriptions.en: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
descriptions.zh: 腐生的特质是英择谛家族美学的见证。也许这是一个教训，告诉那些凝视虚空的人如何在奢华与虚无的融合中发现美。

descriptions.en: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
descriptions.zh: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

descriptions.en: Leggings for a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 漂泊者套装的绑腿。

descriptions.en: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

descriptions.en: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

descriptions.en: Leggings for a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 漂泊者套装的绑腿。

descriptions.en: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
descriptions.zh: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

descriptions.en: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
descriptions.zh: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

descriptions.en: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer pants and boots. Fitted for The Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵裤装和靴子深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

descriptions.en: An armor design honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills. Fitted for the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 一款充满设计感的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。适用于漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。适用于漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind. Fitted for the Drifter.
descriptions.zh: 受到年迈预言家的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。适用于漂泊者。

descriptions.en: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
descriptions.zh: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

descriptions.en: Drifter armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
descriptions.zh: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

descriptions.en: Leggings for a Drifter outfit.
descriptions.zh: 漂泊者套装的绑腿。

descriptions.en: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Drifter armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews.
descriptions.zh: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制。

descriptions.en: Drifter armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat.
descriptions.zh: 灵感来自那些必须在灼热环境下工作的索拉里斯人。

descriptions.en: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical Drifter armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
descriptions.zh: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的漂泊者护甲专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

descriptions.en: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
descriptions.zh: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

descriptions.en: Drifter Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
descriptions.zh: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的漂泊者护甲。

names.zh: 通风泡博通风小子护胫

descriptions.en: A unique skin for the Saryn Warframe, designed by Mz-3.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 战甲的独特外观，由 Mz-3 设计。

descriptions.en: A helmet for the Saryn Warframe, designed by Hitsu San.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 战甲的头盔，由 Hitsu San 设计。

descriptions.en: A unique skin for the Saryn Warframe, designed by Hitsu San.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 战甲的独特外观，由 Hitsu San 设计。

descriptions.en: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
descriptions.zh: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

descriptions.en: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
descriptions.zh: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

descriptions.en: Saryn Orphid's signature helmet.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 兰花的标志性头盔

descriptions.en: Bloom into a beautiful yet deadly agent of the Lotus.
descriptions.zh: 绽放为美丽而致命的 Lotus 特工。

descriptions.en: Saryn Yuheng's signature helmet.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 玉恒的标志性头盔。

descriptions.en: Take on the look of a moon goddess to celebrate Lunar Renewal.
descriptions.zh: 装扮成月亮女神来庆祝农历新年。

descriptions.en: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Prime Warframe.
descriptions.zh: Saryn Prime 的标准头盔。

descriptions.en: The standard issue skin for the Saryn Prime Warframe.
descriptions.zh: Saryn Prime 的标准外观配置。

descriptions.en: The standard issue skin for the Saryn Warframe.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 的标准外观配置。

descriptions.en: Minerva's signature sunglasses.
descriptions.zh: 米尼娃的标志性太阳镜。

descriptions.en: Minerva's signature sunglasses.
descriptions.zh: 米尼娃的标志性太阳镜。

descriptions.en: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Prime Warframe.
descriptions.zh: Saryn Prime 的标准头盔。

descriptions.en:
Minerva Hendricks, former Libertatian military agent, brings a human face to the Saryn Warframe.

Switch between Saryn and Minerva's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Minerva Gemini Emote, even during missions.
descriptions.zh:
米尼娃·亨德里克斯是前自由军特工，她为 Saryn 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的米尼娃双子表情动作，在 Saryn 和米尼娃的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

descriptions.en: Like a carnivorous flower, this alluring Syandana conceals a dangerous predator.
descriptions.zh: 就像一朵肉食性的花一样，这件披饰的诱人外表下潜藏着一个危险的捕食者。

descriptions.en: A Tenno Syandana evocative of winged night creatures.
descriptions.zh: 一件 Tenno 披饰，令人联想到有翅膀的夜之生物。

descriptions.en: A traditional garment, popular with high ranking Tenno.
descriptions.zh: 一件传统服装，在高等 Tenno 中很受欢迎。

descriptions.en: Austere crystalline beauty, formed over time, deceptively delicate, lethally sharp. The Stratum Syandana perfectly compliments Karst, Atlas' deluxe skin.
descriptions.zh: 随着时间的推移形成了简朴的结晶美，看似脆弱却又尖锐致命。地层披饰完美地装点了岩溶， Atlas 的华丽外观。

descriptions.en: Walk the cutting edge of fashion with this exclusive Ki'Teer original.
descriptions.zh: 搭配 Ki'teer 原创的独占披饰，行于时尚的锐利锋缘。

descriptions.en: The refined Razza Syandana, enriched further by the sheen of this bronzed Elixis skin.
descriptions.zh: 精致的类种披饰在古铜色的皮革映衬下更显光彩夺目。

descriptions.en: Exude style and poise with this refined accessory.
descriptions.zh: 用这款精致的配饰来彰显出格调与风度。

descriptions.en: Flaunt your impeccable taste in a Ki’Teer original syandana.
descriptions.zh: 身着 Ki'Teer 的原创披饰炫耀你无可挑剔的品味。

descriptions.en: The glow of the Khinn Syandana inspires inward reflection.
descriptions.zh: 经行披饰的光芒激发着内心的沉思。

descriptions.en: Roiling and swirling with the promise and threat of a thunderhead, the Cumulus Syandana is for those Tenno who dwell among the clouds.
descriptions.zh: 在雷霆的允诺和威力下飘摇吧，这个积云披饰是为那些住在云间的 Tenno 们所设计的。

descriptions.en: Custom edition of the Kyroptera Syandana forged by Tenno artisans.
descriptions.zh: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版蝙蝠披饰。

descriptions.en: Take command with this imposing cloak.
descriptions.zh: 带着这壮丽的斗篷来发出指令。

descriptions.en: A procedurally-designed Syandana possessed of proportions pleasing to 87.8% of Cephalons.
descriptions.zh: 一件由程序设计的披饰，可以取悦 87.8% 的中枢。

descriptions.en: Delicate blooms framed by vicious thorns warn: beauty can still be deadly. Citrine Aphrodita’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 娇艳的花朵被恶毒的荆棘衬托，警示着：美丽也可能致命。Citrine 美神的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Displays Daily and Weekly Conclave Challenge and Mission progress, with a beam of light for each completed challenge or mission.
descriptions.zh: 能够在每天和每周显示武形秘仪挑战和任务进程，每完成一项挑战或任务便会点亮一道光。

descriptions.en: An opulent display of privilege for the Corpus elite becomes a trophy for the Tenno who fight them.
descriptions.zh: 一组特別赐给 Corpus 精英华贵展示品，如今成为与之对抗的 Tenno 的战利品。

descriptions.en: A Corpus-inspired Syandana that responds to the wearer's well-being, unfolding in response to damage. As you endure the Flox unfolds.
descriptions.zh: 一款受 Corpus 所启发的披饰，反映穿着者的状态，受到伤害时披饰展开。

descriptions.en: Extol the virtues of Profit with this Corpus-styled Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 以这件 Corpus 风格的披饰来赞扬利润的美德。

descriptions.en: March through the battlefield with this Corpus cloak.
descriptions.zh: 身着这件 Corpus 斗篷于战场上行军。

descriptions.en: Embody the festive spirit with this brightly painted syandana that evokes a magnificent bird.
descriptions.zh: 这款色彩鲜艳、犹如尊贵飞鸟的披饰体现了节日风采。

names.en: Monarcierro Day of the Dead Syandana

descriptions.en: Pay tribute to the fallen with this festive syandana.
descriptions.zh: 以这款节日披饰向逝者致敬。

names.en: Saturn Six Day of the Dead Syandana

descriptions.en: Reclaimed from the battlefields of Tau, this battle-worn syandana reflects the cost of war.
descriptions.zh: 这件从 Tau 的战场上缴获的披饰，饱经战火洗礼，它反映了战争的代价。

descriptions.en: A syandana once worn to distinguish Dax commanders on Tau; wear it now as a mark of pride.
descriptions.zh: 这是曾经用来在 Tau 上区分禁卫指挥官的披饰；现在佩戴它是一种荣耀的象征。

descriptions.en: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
descriptions.zh: 宛如蝴蝶的翅膀破蛹而出，这款披饰似乎被注入了神秘的力量。

descriptions.en: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the fourth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
descriptions.zh: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻催眠中醒来 4 周年。

descriptions.en: Once worn exclusively by Orokin Judiciary, the Yamako Syandana is a symbol of wisdom and authority.
descriptions.zh: 山越披饰是一种传统的 Tenno 服饰。曾经只有奥罗金的法官才能穿戴，山越披饰是智慧和权威的象征。
通过这件诡异披饰来主宰黑夜。
长寿的愿望承载在 Narin 标志性披饰的高贵羽翼之上。

descriptions.en: Ember's Fourth Law of Thermodynamics: look good doing it.
descriptions.zh: Ember 的热力学第四定律：做起来要好看点。

descriptions.en: The signature syandana of Ember Vermillion.
descriptions.zh: Ember 朱红的标志性披饰

descriptions.en: A traditional Tenno garment, this Syandana is woven from ancient, Orokin synthetic thread.
descriptions.zh: 传统 Tenno 服装，这条披饰源自远古时期，由奥罗金合成纤维所编织而成。

descriptions.en: The Void's corrupting energy has scarred this syandana, leaving it permanently out of phase with conventional space.
descriptions.zh: 虚空的堕落能量让这件披饰伤痕累累，使它拥有完全迥异的外观。

descriptions.en: Rise and fall, ebb and flow, peace and war. A signature Syandana for Equinox.
descriptions.zh: 盛衰兴废，潮起潮落，玉帛干戈。Equinox 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Evokes stone scarred but not destroyed by the sea's tireless onslaught.
descriptions.zh: 让人联想起那被不休海潮冲刷得伤痕累累却又没有破裂的巨石。

descriptions.en: This wing-like syandana invokes the beauty and agility of the Ceresean Butterfly Sparrow.
descriptions.zh: 这件翼状般的披饰呼应着自谷神蝶雀的美丽与轻灵。

descriptions.en: During the Orokin Era, only the most fierce warriors were permitted to wear this flaming Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 在奥罗金时代，只有最凶猛的战士们才被准许穿戴这件火焰般的披饰

descriptions.en: Full spectrum flames dance around this evolved Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 全光谱的火焰在这个进化后的披饰上舞动。

descriptions.en: Flows like grace. Flows like blood. An asymmetrical, stain-resistant Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 飘姿秀逸、淌若鲜血。一款可防渍的非对称披饰

descriptions.en: After the butchery, bones.
descriptions.zh: 残杀过后，仅余枯骨。

descriptions.en: Gauss Kresnik’s signature Syandana proves he can stand the heat.
descriptions.zh: Gauss 火神的标志性披饰证明他可以承受住高温的考验。

descriptions.en: Sleekly aerodynamic, Gauss Moto's signature syandana is made for speed.
descriptions.zh: Gauss 摩托的标志性流线型空气动力学披饰，专为极速而生。

descriptions.en: Panes of polished glass complete this elegant Syandana. Like Gara herself, it is less fragile than it looks.
descriptions.zh: 抛光的玻璃让这件优雅的披饰更加完美。就像 Gara 她本人一样，它并不像看上去的那样脆弱。

descriptions.en: Be prepared for anything from a firefight to a midnight snack with Grendel Turbis' signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 佩戴 Grendel 暴坦的标志性披饰，无论是战场交锋还是午夜加餐，都要随时做好准备。

descriptions.en: A syandana of Grineer design. Matches the Harkonar Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 由 Grineer 设计的披饰。与哈库那护甲套装配套。

descriptions.en: A syandana assembled from the scavenged internals of some unidentified mechanism, it is still dusty from the desert where it was found.
descriptions.zh: 这是一个由一些未被识别的机械内部残骸组装而成的披饰，它依然沾染着从它被发现之地带来的沙砾。

descriptions.en: Once worn by an elegant Elder Queen, before time and disease left her body mangled and disfigured.
descriptions.zh: 在身体被时间与疾病给折磨到残破不堪以前，优雅的大女皇曾穿着这件斗篷。

descriptions.en: Symbolizing the corrupting power of the Grineer Queens.
descriptions.zh: 象征了 Grineer 双子女皇的腐化力量。

descriptions.en: Fashioned with spare field components this cloak is an example of rarely seen creativity within the Grineer ranks.
descriptions.zh: 这件由备用的战备零件打造而成的斗篷可是 Grinneer 兵队中罕见的创造性的例证之一。

descriptions.en: A prototype destined for one of Tyl Regor’s experiments, this syandana has been repurposed for Tenno Agents.
descriptions.zh: 原为泰尔·雷工众多实验之一的预定原型，这件披饰现已易主为 Tenno 特工所使用。

descriptions.en: Victory over the Grineer, draped across your shoulders.
descriptions.zh: 战胜 Grineer 的象征，披挂在你的肩膀。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the departed with this colorful Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 通过这件色彩缤纷的披饰来纪念逝者。

names.en: Izvara Day of the Dead Syandana

descriptions.en: A morbidly festive syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一件令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格披饰。

names.en: Abrasys Day of the Dead Syandana

descriptions.en: An Igaro Syandana adorned with a morbidly festive design.
descriptions.zh: 令人毛骨悚然的伊卡洛披饰节庆风格外观。

names.en: Igaro Day of the Dead Syandana
names.zh: 伊卡洛 亡灵节披饰

descriptions.en: A Vanquished Banner that has been adorned with a morbidly festive design.
descriptions.zh: 以令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格所装饰的战败旗帜。

names.en: Vanquished Banner Day of the Dead
names.zh: 战败旗帜 亡灵节披饰

descriptions.en: A morbidly festive syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一件令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格披饰。

names.en: Kyroptera Day of the Dead Syandana

descriptions.en: The sun rises on the victor and sets upon the vanquished. This is how your legend is made. Adorn yourself with this exquisite syandana, worthy of the sun herself.
descriptions.zh: 太阳在胜利者上升起，在被征服者身上落下。这就是你传说的诞生之处。用这个精致的披饰装点自己，无愧于太阳本身。

descriptions.en: A festive variation of the Imperator Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一条改款节庆版的凯旋将军披饰

descriptions.en: The Rakta Syandana is awarded by the Red Veil for exemplary valor. This honor is rarely given to outsiders.
descriptions.zh: 绯红披饰是来自血色面纱象征英勇典范的奖赏，这项荣誉鲜少给予外来者。

descriptions.en: Used for festive ceremonies, this Syandana was often worn during social gatherings.
descriptions.zh: 这件披饰经常在节日庆典时的社交场合中穿戴。

descriptions.en: Get decked out in this coat inspired by the surf and sand.
descriptions.zh: 用这件灵感来自海浪和沙滩的长衣进行一番打扮。

descriptions.en: Jagged, crystalline spikes crown a shroud of snowy mist in this ice themed syandana.
descriptions.zh: 在这款以冰为主题的披饰中，参差不齐的冰晶尖刺外笼罩着一层雪雾。

descriptions.en: The signature syandana of Inaros Ramses.
descriptions.zh: Inaros 拉美西斯的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Bring forth the look of your inner beast.
descriptions.zh: 释放你内心的野性。

descriptions.en: Pulsing with a bioluminescent glow, this syandana is eye-catchingly contagious.
descriptions.zh: 散发着律动般的生物冷光，这款披饰有着引人注目的感染力。

descriptions.en: Pursue your prey with a look that combines beast and Infestation.
descriptions.zh: 用一种融合了野兽与感染者的外表追击你的猎物。

descriptions.en: Chitin, cartilage and nectar. This Infested Syandana once twitched with unsettling life.
descriptions.zh: 几丁质、软骨组织，以及花蜜。这件感染披饰曾经发出让人不安的抖动。

descriptions.en: A sinuous spine of Infested anatomy.
descriptions.zh: 感染者解剖后的弯曲脊椎。

descriptions.en: A crown of bone spawns a mass of writhing, meaty, Infested tentacles.
descriptions.zh: 一件骨盔上恣意生长着扭曲、多肉的感染触手。

descriptions.en: An infested syandana made from living tissue. Matches the Iliac Armor Set.
descriptions.zh: 一个用活体组织制造出的感染披饰。与髂骨护甲组合配套。

descriptions.en: The signature syandana of Ivara Skathi.
descriptions.zh: Ivara 冬之女神的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Ivara Prime's signature Syandana.
descriptions.zh: Ivara Prime 的标志性披饰。

names.zh: 阿帕瓦哒 Prime 披饰

descriptions.en: A next-generation syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一件次世代的披饰。

descriptions.en: A next-generation syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一件次世代的披饰。

descriptions.en: A next-generation syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一件次世代的披饰。

names.zh: 凯旋将军 翡翠披饰

descriptions.en: Define style with this crystalline cape.
descriptions.zh: 用这款水晶般的披风定义你的风格。

descriptions.en: This malignant growth hangs elegantly on the shoulders of any Tenno.
descriptions.zh: 这恶性生长之物可以优雅地披挂于任何 Tenno 的肩膀。

descriptions.en: Flowing lines meet sharpened spikes in Khora Prime's signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 流畅的线条与尖锐的钉刺在 Khora Prime 的标志性披饰中相逢。

descriptions.en: Once chains of binding guilt, now twisted into a defiant ornament. The signature Syandana of Kullervo Apostate.
descriptions.zh: 曾是束缚罪孽的锁链，如今扭曲成一个象征反抗的装饰物。这是 Kullervo 叛徒的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Be prepared no matter where with everything you need for the long haul, including Drippy, the K.O.L. virtual assistant. "No need for waterworks, Drippy is here to help!"
descriptions.zh: 无论身在何处，都要准备好应对长期发展所需的一切，包括即时网虚拟助手滴答。"无需费力，滴答助你一臂之力！"

names.zh: 即时网滴答助攻战术披饰

descriptions.en: Only the most highly trained - or highly reckless - Scaldra dare to wear this portable Efervon container.
descriptions.zh: 只有训练有素——或者极其鲁莽——的炽蛇军才敢佩戴这种便携式艾弗旺容器。

descriptions.en: Many a specimen has felt the sting of this wearable apparatus. Lavos Khymia’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 许多实验对象都曾感受到这件可穿戴设备的刺痛。Lavos 点金的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: A Syandana that dances upon the eddies of battle and void-currents alike.
descriptions.zh: 一款在战场及虚空流电的旋涡上舞动的披饰。

descriptions.en: Take to the stars with this sleek Syandana. Strapping in feels just like home.
descriptions.zh: 带着这款柔滑的披饰前往各种行星。戴着它会有种如家的感觉。

descriptions.en: Mag Pneuma’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: Mag 元气的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Venture into uncharted territory with Mesa Presidio’s signature Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 佩戴 Mesa 边塞的标志性披饰前去未知的领域冒险。

descriptions.en: An elite version of the Kyroptera Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 蝙蝠披饰的精英版本。

descriptions.en: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics or Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock two additional looks.
descriptions.zh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物或阿耶精华时，会额外解锁两个外观。

descriptions.en: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology. Collect Relics and Aya with this Syandana equipped to unlock an additional look.
descriptions.zh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。装备这款披饰收集遗物和阿耶精华时，会额外解锁一个外观。

descriptions.en: An evolving Syandana that draws upon Sentient technology.
descriptions.zh: 一款利用 Sentient 技术发展出的可进化披饰。

descriptions.en: Flaunt wealth and prosperity with a constant stream of financial data.
descriptions.zh: 用这股持续不断的财政数据流来炫耀财富与昌盛。

descriptions.en: Painstakingly embellished with scavenged gold as a treaty gift for the Orokin, this Sentient spinal symbiote serves as Caliban Prime’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 作为与奥罗金签订的条约礼物，这个 Sentient 脊椎异融者由搜集而来的黄金精心装饰，是 Caliban Prime 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: The strength of the mountain; the grace of flowing water.
descriptions.zh: 山脉之力，流水之雅。

descriptions.en: This humble Syandana is modeled on those worn by the Children of Reshantur, who formed into a clan devoted to Nezha in defense of their home.
descriptions.zh: 这件朴素的披饰是根据瑞圣途的孩子们曾穿戴过的样式设计而来的，那些孩子们组成了一支信奉 Nezha 的小型氏族来保卫他们的家园。

descriptions.en: The signature Syandana of Nidus Phryke.
descriptions.zh: Nidus 恐惧神的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Beauty and dread combine in this unique Infested Syandana, alive with swaying gilded tentacles.
descriptions.zh: 美丽与恐惧在这件独特的感染者披饰中融为一体，镀金的触须摇曳生姿。

descriptions.en: A next-generation syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一件次世代的披饰。

descriptions.en: Nokko’s trusty pack carries everything needed for a long day of caring for the fruits n’ roots. Nokko’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: Nokko 的可靠背包里装着一整天照料果子和根所需的一切。Nokko 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: A relic from another time, this syandana is a highly ornamental and prized garment.
descriptions.zh: 来自于其他时代的遗物，这条披饰是一种极具观赏性的珍贵服装。

descriptions.zh: Nova 阿修罗的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: The signature syandana of Nova Atomica.
descriptions.zh: Nova 原子姬的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Strike a cutting figure with Nyx’s mesmerizing signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用 Nyx 迷人的标志性披饰为打造出一个凛冽的仪表。

descriptions.zh: 一件次世代的披饰。

descriptions.en: Next-generation Tenno design, enviable and cutting-edge.
descriptions.zh: Tenno 的次世代设计，令人艳羡且走在时尚前沿。

descriptions.en: This Syandana of corded-knots wrapped in linen is used by Baruuk for meditation and contemplation.
descriptions.zh: 亚麻布包裹的绳状披饰，被 Baruuk 使用于冥想和沉思。

descriptions.en: The Void makes its mark on Kullervo's signature Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 虚空在 Kullervo 的标志性披饰上留下了自己的印记。

descriptions.en: Harrow’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: Harrow 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: The ornate charms on this Syandana represent the ideal of serenity.
descriptions.zh: 这件披饰上的华丽坠饰代表了宁静的理想。

descriptions.en: A shining garment befitting the Saint of Altra.
descriptions.zh: 适合阿尔特拉圣者的闪亮服装。

names.zh: 阿尔特拉 Prime 披饰

descriptions.en: A techno-organic Syandana, reimagined with regal flair worthy of the Orokin elite.
descriptions.zh: 一款科技有机披饰，重塑奥罗金精英的高贵气质。

descriptions.en: The bold, wing-like arcs of this Syandana have been crafted to complement the Avia Prime armor.
descriptions.zh: 这件不羁的、像翅膀一样的弧形披饰，是为了搭配飞空 Prime 护甲而精心打造的。

descriptions.en: A flowing river of light and grace, a Syandana fit for royalty.
descriptions.zh: 充盈着光与优雅的流动之河，此乃适合高贵之人的披饰。

descriptions.en: A blade-like cut in regal red-and-gold, reminiscent of the elite honor guards of ancient Mars.
descriptions.zh: 庄严的红色与金色构成的利刃，令人回想起旧日火星上的精英御卫。
Citrine Prime 的标志性披饰闪耀着璀璨的光芒。

descriptions.en: A ceremonial version of the Pyra that drapes the entire back in a cape of flames.
descriptions.zh: 庆典版的珮菈，一条披挂在背部的火焰披风。

descriptions.en: The signature Syandana of the gilded gourmand, Grendel Prime.
descriptions.zh: 镀金美食家 Grendel Prime 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Enchant onlookers with the crystalline adornments of Gyre Prime's signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Gyre Prime 标志性披饰的晶莹剔透的装饰来吸引旁观者。

descriptions.en: A regal Syandana and a record of Inaros' legacy.
descriptions.zh: 一件帝王的披饰，Inaros 的遗迹的载体。

descriptions.en: Step into oblivion with the signature syandana of Limbo Prime.
descriptions.zh: 用 Limbo Prime 的标志性披饰步入遗忘边境。

descriptions.en: Yareli Prime’s faithful water-glider is happy to adorn her body as an additional ornament.
descriptions.zh: Yareli Prime 忠实的水上滑行者很乐意成为她身上额外的装饰品。

names.zh: 浪漪珊瑚 Prime 披饰

descriptions.en: Invest Harrow Prime with this golden Syandana of holy office.
descriptions.zh: 授予 Harrow Prime 这件圣职用的金色披饰。

descriptions.en: This long, powerful ribbon symbolizes the Tenno path toward balance.
descriptions.zh: 这条长而有力的缎带标志着 Tenno 的平衡之道。

descriptions.en: Awe the crowds with this majestic flourish of a Syandana, fit for the mistress of the Mandachord.
descriptions.zh: 这款华丽曼妙的披饰，不仅能让听众折服，与那位演奏曼达和弦琴的女音乐家更是绝配。

descriptions.en: A spectral glow emanates from this ornate syandana.
descriptions.zh: 这件华丽的披饰散发着鬼魅的幽光。

descriptions.en: Sumptuous details suit Parvos Granum's favored guardian.
descriptions.zh: 华丽的细节非常适合帕尔沃斯·格拉努最喜爱的守护者。

descriptions.en: Discovered in the vaults of a drifting derelict, this Syandana was worn by Temple Guardians before the fall of the Orokin Empire
descriptions.zh: 这件披饰是在漂流的遗迹宝库中被发现，在奥罗金帝国灭亡之前是由神庙守卫所穿戴。

descriptions.en: The signature Syandana of Atlas Prime.
descriptions.zh: Atlas Prime 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: This graceful cape is the signature Syandana of Banshee Prime.
descriptions.zh: 这件优雅的披风是 Banshee Prime 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Mirage Prime’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: Mirage Prime 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Evoking fortress designs of the ancient past, this is Vauban Prime's signature Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 这件 Vauban Prime 的标志性披饰令人联想到远古时期的要塞设计。

descriptions.en: A syandana of gold and ethereal glory, for intimidation on the battlefield or celebration in the victory parade.
descriptions.zh: 一件金光闪闪、光彩夺目的披饰，用于战场上的威慑或胜利游行中的庆祝。

descriptions.en: Feel the energy of the Surator Prime Syandana at your back as you feel the drive to push on.
descriptions.zh: 感受雪瑞达 Prime 披饰在你背后的能量，这是你前进的动力。

descriptions.en: Twin bands symbolize the balance all Tenno are sworn to uphold.
descriptions.zh: 其两根带子象征了所有 Tenno 发誓要维护的平衡。

descriptions.en: Wear the trophy of victories past with Voruna Prime's signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Voruna Prime 的标志性披饰彰显过往胜利的荣耀。

descriptions.en: Call upon the preternatural with Wisp Prime’s signature Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用 Wisp Prime 的标志性披饰召唤超自然力量。

descriptions.en: A sleek Syandana that yearns to journey among the clouds.
descriptions.zh: 一副造型优美的披饰，展现出要在云间遨游的渴望。

descriptions.en: Shimmering prisma crystals give this syandana a mesmerizing sheen.
descriptions.zh: 微光闪烁的棱晶为这件配饰带来迷人的光辉。
Qorvex 圣殿的标志性披饰栖息在你的肩膀上，锐利的目光俯瞰一切。

descriptions.en: Khora's standard back spikes.
descriptions.zh: Khora 的标准背部豪刺。

descriptions.en: Flowing lines meet sharpened spikes in Khora’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 流畅的线条与尖锐的钉刺在 Khora 的标志性披饰中相逢。

descriptions.en: The Syandana is a traditional Tenno garment. This variation was often worn during the Tenno Absolution Ceremony.
descriptions.zh: 这件披饰是一种传统的 Tenno 服装，通常只有在 Tenno 的仪式上才会穿戴。

descriptions.en: A Syandana fit for a knight.
descriptions.zh: 能匹配上一名骑士的披饰。

descriptions.en: This syandana has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
descriptions.zh: 这件披饰以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。

descriptions.en: A sizzling take on the classic Samia Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用酷热的方式来展现经典的眉纹天蚕蛾披饰。

descriptions.en: Found deep in the rubble at Altra, this Syandana is thought to have been worn by Gauss on the day he broke through enemy lines, decisively ending that bloody siege.
descriptions.zh: 这件在阿尔特拉废墟深处发现的披饰，被认为是 Gauss 在突破敌人防线，果断结束那场血腥围攻时所穿过的。

descriptions.en: A Sentient spinal symbiote that functions as Caliban’s signature Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一个 Sentient 的脊椎共生体，现在成为了 Caliban 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: A Syandana with kick, as robust as Hildryn herself.
descriptions.zh: 够带劲的披饰，像 Hildryn 一样强壮。

descriptions.en: Fury tempered. Pride soothed. This unity was hard-won, and all the more precious for it.
descriptions.zh: 怒火平息，骄傲抚平。这份团结来之不易，也因此更加珍贵。

descriptions.en: Swaddling cloth of the infant Orion, torn in ecstatic fury.
descriptions.zh: 包裹着幼年 Orion 的襁褓布，在狂喜的愤怒中被撕碎。

descriptions.en: Swaddling cloth of the infant Sirius, worn as a ragged badge of honor.
descriptions.zh: 包裹着幼年 Sirius 的襁褓布，被当作一枚破旧的荣誉勋章佩戴着。

descriptions.en: A Ki'Teer Syandana that has been adorned with a festive design.
descriptions.zh: 由节庆设计装饰的 Ki'Teer 披饰。

descriptions.en: A Centuria Syandana that has been adorned with a festive design.
descriptions.zh: 一件用节日设计装点的百人披饰。

descriptions.en: A Vanquished Banner that has been adorned with a festive design.
descriptions.zh: 拥有节庆装饰的战败旗帜。

descriptions.en: A Kuva Cloak that has been adorned with a festive design.
descriptions.zh: 装饰着节庆风格的赤毒斗篷。

descriptions.en: A familiar Solstice Syandana re-imagined and renewed.
descriptions.zh: 熟悉的冬至披饰得到了重塑和翻新。

descriptions.en: An Izvara Syandana that has been adorned with a festive design.
descriptions.zh: 一件拥有节庆独特设计的自在披饰。

descriptions.en: Formed from the bones of Sentient fighters and given to the Stalker by Hunhow.
descriptions.zh: 由 Sentient 战士的骨头制成，是 Hunhow 赐予给追猎者的。

descriptions.en: Spread your monolithic wings.
descriptions.zh: 展翼高飞。

descriptions.en: A Centuria Syandana that has been adorned with a sizzling design.
descriptions.zh: 这件百人披饰装饰着令人感到酷热的设计。

descriptions.en: A Maggor Syandana that has been adorned with a sizzling design.
descriptions.zh: 玛戈披饰上装饰着酷热的造型。

descriptions.en: With every enemy struck down the Telos Syandana glows stronger.
descriptions.zh: 随着每击倒一位敌人 ，终极披饰的光芒将愈加闪耀。

descriptions.en: The Synoid Syandana glows more brightly with every scan performed.
descriptions.zh: 枢议披饰会在每一次成功的扫描后更加光亮。

descriptions.en: The Sancti Syandana pulses every time the Tenno uses an ability and continues to strengthen with each ability used.
descriptions.zh: 圣洁披饰会在 Tenno 每次使用技能的时候发出脉冲，并在每次使用技能时继续加强效果。

descriptions.en: This Secura Syandana pulses every time a Tenno picks up credits and glows brighter as their wealth increases.
descriptions.zh: 保障披饰会在 Tenno 每次捡取现金时候发出脉冲，并在每次财富增加时发出更亮的光芒。

descriptions.en: This Asita Rakta Syandana ignites a jet of flames that burns brighter with each stealth takedown.
descriptions.zh: 隐士绯红披饰会在每次的暗杀燃起火焰，并且愈燃愈亮。

descriptions.en: The Vaykor Syandana flares up whenever the Tenno takes damage.
descriptions.zh: 勇气披饰会在 Tenno 受到伤害时燃烧起来。

descriptions.en: This tattered variant syandana displays the wearer's ability to manipulate the Void.
descriptions.zh: 这块破旧的变体披饰，彰显了佩戴者操纵虚空的能力。

names.zh: 虚空防御者披饰（虚空侵蚀）

descriptions.en: This Void-swept cape transitions into its normal form when the TennoCon Riftguard Emote is used. Created to celebrate the tenth anniversary of Tennocon.
descriptions.zh: 使用 TennoCon 裂隙护卫表情动作时，这件被虚空侵蚀的斗篷会化为正常形态。为庆祝 TennoCon 十周年而创作。

names.zh: TennoCon 裂隙护卫披饰（虚空侵蚀）

descriptions.en: Stand guard against the allure of the Void with this opulent syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用这件华丽的披饰抵御虚空的诱惑。

descriptions.en: This flowing cape transitions into its tattered Void-swept form when the TennoCon Riftguard Emote is used. Created to celebrate ten years of TennoCon in 2025.
descriptions.zh: 使用 TennoCon 裂隙护卫表情动作时，这件飘逸的斗篷会化为残破的虚空侵蚀形态。为庆祝 2025 年 TennoCon 十周年而创作。

descriptions.en: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
descriptions.zh: 将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。

descriptions.zh: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2017 的玩家。

descriptions.en: A syandana inspired by the brutality of life inside the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
descriptions.zh: 一件灵感源自于土星六号最高戒备监狱里残酷生命的披饰。

descriptions.en: A glowing syandana of the deadly night.
descriptions.zh: 一件致命之夜的发光披饰。

descriptions.en: A miniature twist on Titania Prime's signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 迷你版的 Titania Prime 标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Titania Prime's signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: Titania Prime 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Lavos' signature Syandana has been engineered for life in the lab and the battlefield.
descriptions.zh: Lavos 的标志性披饰经过精心设计，适用于实验室和战场的日常使用。

descriptions.en: With time and fire the truth of bone is revealed. The signature Syandana of Ash Shroud.
descriptions.zh: 伴随着时间与烈火，骨头的真面目被揭示。Ash 裹尸布的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: This techno-organic syandana fits over the shoulder, producing a unique, spiked silhouette.
descriptions.zh: 这件有机科技披饰与肩部贴合，勾勒出独特且又突出的轮廓。

descriptions.en: Wear this ribbon Syandana as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
descriptions.zh: 佩戴此缎带披饰作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

descriptions.en: Qorvex's signature Syandana looks like stone but remains as light as it is stylish.
descriptions.zh: Qorvex 的标志性披饰看起来像石头，但却轻巧时尚。

descriptions.en: Gara’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: Gara 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Windswept ribbons of crimson evoke the war-kites of ancient earth.
descriptions.zh: 迎风飘扬的绯红缎带唤起了对古老地球的战争风筝的记忆。

descriptions.en: Amplify your look with Gyre’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用 Gyre 的标志性披饰来强化你的造型。

descriptions.en: The beauty of the orchid paired with the elegance of Tenno design. A signature Syandana for Khora.
descriptions.zh: 兰花的美丽与 Tenno 设计的典雅相辅相成。Khora 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: This flowing Tenno cape is supported by an intricately sculpted brooch.
descriptions.zh: 这款流畅的 Tenno 披饰由雕刻复杂的饰针支撑着。

descriptions.en: Draw attention with the bold geometric patterns in this exclusive Broca Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 用这件专属的布洛卡披饰上大块的几何图案来吸引注意力。

descriptions.en: This winter rendering is a perfect fit for the geometric patterns of the Broca syandana.
descriptions.zh: 这款冬季外观与布洛卡披饰的几何图案完美契合。

descriptions.en: A next-generation syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一件次世代的披饰。

descriptions.en: Tenno design at its finest. This classic syandana was inspired by the elegant drapery of the Orokin.
descriptions.zh: Tenno 设计的杰出代表。这款经典披饰的灵感来自于奥罗金的优雅帷幔。

descriptions.en: An arcing syandana with refined highlights and distinctive technical elements.
descriptions.zh: 一款具有精致亮点与独特科技元素的弧形披饰。

descriptions.en: Make a breathtaking entrance with the syncopated design of the Verismo Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 佩戴这款切分音设计的写实歌剧披饰来进行一次惊心动魄的登场。

descriptions.en: A confident warrior strides into battle, but the truly brazen announce their presence with an ostentatious flourish. The Rhoptron is Protea's signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: 一位自信的勇士会大踏步迈入战斗，但真正的无耻之徒会以更浮夸的举动来宣告他们的存在。铃鼓是 Protea 的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: A most curious syandana, and one favored by the gallant gourmand, Grendel.
descriptions.zh: 一款造型别致的披饰，深受豪爽美食家 Grendel 的青睐。

descriptions.en: A Syandana reminiscent of scriptoriums.
descriptions.zh: 一件让人联想到抄写室的披饰。

descriptions.en: Advance into the heat of battle.
descriptions.zh: 勇往直前，投身战火。

descriptions.en: Flash across the battlefield with this syandana that elevates the original design of House Sigma.
descriptions.zh: 穿上这款升级自西格玛系列原版设计的披饰，在战场上闪耀。

descriptions.en: This Syandana was a mark of honor, and part of the battle dress of Warframe Railjack crews.
descriptions.zh: 这款披饰是荣誉的标记，是 Warframe 航道星舰舰员战斗服的一部分。

descriptions.en: A satisfyingly coordinated Syandana that is more than the sum of its parts.
descriptions.zh: 一件整体协调到令人满意的披饰，而不仅是它的各个部分的简单相加。

descriptions.en: Put on a striking display with this fanciful syandana.
descriptions.zh: 将这款奇特的披饰摆在醒目位置。

descriptions.en: A syandana for the intrepid.
descriptions.zh: 为无畏而生的披饰。

descriptions.en: Stay on the true path with this compass inspired Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 戴着这基于罗盘构想的披饰在正道上继续前行。

descriptions.en: Volt Proto’s signature syandana.
descriptions.zh: Volt 原型的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: Wisp Somnium's signature Syandana evokes the light and shadow of a solar eclipse.
descriptions.zh: Wisp 星梦的标志性披饰唤出日食的光影。

descriptions.en: A flowing, contoured Syandana for Sevagoth, the dark Helmsman.
descriptions.zh: 一款为黑暗舵手 Sevagoth 设计的流动且轮廓分明的披饰。

descriptions.en: Before the fall, the Imperator Syandana was bestowed upon only the highest-ranking Orokin commanders.
descriptions.zh: 在奥罗金帝国衰败之前，只有最高阶的奥罗金将领才能被授予凯旋将军披饰。

descriptions.en: Dazzle the crowds with this stylish high-concept Syandana, modelled for elegance.
descriptions.zh: 这款时尚且拥有尖端概念的披饰让人眼花缭乱，造型异常优雅。

descriptions.en: See and be seen with this captivating Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 以这件迷人的披饰成为时尚新宠儿。

names.zh: 华丽演出 Prime 披饰

descriptions.en: Bring the early light of Sol to this late-Orokin Dax Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 让太阳神初晓的光辉，照耀这件奥罗金晚期的禁卫披饰。

descriptions.en: Worn in battle and ceremony by late-Orokin Dax, this Syandana was seen as a symbol of power to all in the empire.
descriptions.zh: 前任奥罗金禁卫将这件披饰穿在战场和典礼中，它被全帝国视为是权力的象征。

descriptions.en: Let these massive segments of interlinked gold and silver ripple down a Warframe’s back.
descriptions.zh: 令那无数交织的金色与银色如水波般飘洒在战甲的背部。

descriptions.en: Forged by Orokin era artisans, this exquisite syandana is finished by bathing its prisma crystal in pure Void energy.
descriptions.zh: 由奥罗金时代的工匠所制造，这条精致的披饰是浸泡在充满虚空能量的棱晶中才完成的。

descriptions.en: This Hecate Syandana has been threaded with filaments of prisma crystals.
descriptions.zh: 这件朔月女神披饰被镶嵌上棱水晶细丝。

names.zh: 棱晶 朔月女神披饰

descriptions.en: Honor a great commander by wearing his distinctive syandana.
descriptions.zh: 佩戴这位伟大统帅的标志性披肩，以示敬意。

descriptions.en: Transmute the chaos of battle into golden triumph.
descriptions.zh: 将战斗的混乱转化为金子般的胜利。

descriptions.zh: 具有象征性的血红版 Grineer 斗篷

descriptions.zh: Wukong 三摩提的标志性披饰。

descriptions.en: An ancient and golden syandana, worn only by those chosen to lead the Orokin High Court.
descriptions.zh: 一款古老的金色披饰，只有那些被挑选出来带领奥罗金高阶枢密院的勇士才能佩戴。

descriptions.en: Dance atop the waves with Yareli's Signature Syandana.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Yareli 的标志性披饰在浪尖起舞。

descriptions.en: The wind uplifts this winglike syandana, as it does all who partake in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
descriptions.zh: 风吹动着这件翼状披饰，就像它吹动着所有参加征服癌症活动的人一样。

descriptions.en: The feather symbol marks those who have not yet ascended to the full sword of the Hexis.
descriptions.zh: 羽毛符号代表那些尚未晋升到能获得完整的均衡之剑的人。

descriptions.en: Let nothing hinder you from safeguarding those you hold dear.
descriptions.zh: 不要让任何事情阻碍你保护你所珍视的人。

descriptions.en: Enlightenment is complete awareness of the shadow.
descriptions.zh: 开悟即是对影子的完全认知。

descriptions.en: A fearsome alternative helmet to give Caliban a look he has not worn since the Old War.
descriptions.zh: 一款可怕的替代头盔，让 Caliban 重现自远古之战以来就从未穿戴过的造型。

descriptions.en: A fragment of Sentient armor suspended above Caliban Orfeo’s right shoulder.
descriptions.zh: 一块悬挂在 Caliban 奥菲欧的右肩上方的 Sentient 护甲碎片。

descriptions.en: Venture boldly into the Otherworld. None shall defeat the one who shows honor in the face of adversity and courage in the face of death.
descriptions.zh: 勇闯异世界。没有人能够打败那些在逆境中展现荣誉、在死亡面前表现勇气的人。

descriptions.zh: 殁世械灵坚持采用古老且可靠的英择谛技术，而不是任何更先进的技术。
